test_title: PYST 36: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Haughty
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Arrogant.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haughty **means** having or showing an attitude of superiority and disdain towards others.**

 
 
• For example, "She had a **haughty **demeanor and looked down on everyone around her."
 
 
 
• **Arrogant **also means **having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities and showing a lack of respect for others.**
 
 
• For example, "He was so **arrogant **that he refused to listen to anyone else's opinions."
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lowly** means humble or of low status.

 
 
• For example, "The **lowly **servant worked tirelessly to please his master."
 
 
 
• **Humble **means having a modest or low view of one's own importance.
 
 
• For example, "She was a **humble **person who never boasted about her achievements."
 
 
 
• **Modest** means having or showing a moderate or humble estimate of one's own abilities or achievements.
 
 
• For example, "He was a **modest **person who never sought attention or praise for his work."
